title: Calm Open Sea and Distant Coastline Horizon, 1957 B&W Ocean Snapshot Photo
description: A quiet black-and-white snapshot showing a tranquil expanse of open water beneath an overcast sky, with a faint, low shoreline barely visible across the flat horizon. Features scalloped deckled edges and a developing stamp on the right front border reading 'JUL 57', evocative of mid-century maritime travel and seaside leisure during the post-war vacation boom in the 1950s.
